lead: Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan was a Pakistani singer, born on 13 October 1948 in Faisalabad.
He died on 16 August 1997 in London at the age of 48.
He has 31 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Pride of Performance and Nigar Awards.
The sections that follow break down Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan was born on 13 October 1948 in Faisalabad, and holds Pakistani nationality.
Public records name his father, Fateh Ali Khan. He is a sibling of Farrukh Fateh Ali Khan.
He is recorded as speaking Urdu.

sections.heading: Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists singer, composer, music educator, storyteller, recording artist and musician as his occupations.
He performs on Indian harmonium and voice.
